scope: Independent read-only re-analysis of frozen source identity, existing raw benchmark records and test logs; no fresh engine search, build, match, or source edits. Only this JSON report was written.

source_provenance.limits: Benchmark source commits are declared metadata, not cryptographic proof of how Windows binaries were compiled. Current executable bytes match every recorded hash; Linux final production/test source manifests match frozen Git blobs after newline normalization. A generated icon import is unrelated to engine compilation.

profile_driver.identity_limit: Profile JSON does not embed binary hash/commit; this audit records current driver bytes and verifies the frozen driver source and corpus.

profile.scope_limit: Evaluator-only cost on the predeclared 58-position corpus; excludes board construction and IO, and cannot infer whole-engine speed or playing strength. Final block showed slower absolute times in every variant; paired ratios mitigate but do not eliminate shared load/clock effects.

fixed_depth_search.engine_time_resolution_note: UCI milliseconds; zero/missing times are excluded from engine-time ratios. Wall includes UCI transaction and new-game reset.

caveats: Samples include only processes present and readable at both endpoints; short-lived new/exited processes are omitted.
Search target is the parent wrapper, while regicide counters include benchmark engines and are not external interference.
No affinity, exclusivity, thermal, frequency, or complete whole-host CPU guarantee.
Subtraction cannot recover omitted children. Browser CPU is an overlapping subgroup of observed total.
Host normalization uses 16 logical CPUs; one saturated logical CPU represents 6.25 percent host capacity.

Residual includes unclassified benchmark child processes such as the Python harness. It cannot be interpreted as external interference alone; all regicide-named processes are grouped together, including benchmark engines.

correctness_evidence.note: Native logs initially contained the prior evaluation group. Final evaluation-only reruns add deterministic en passant/promotion/undo coverage. Final source hashes match frozen commit; merged counts use replacement, never double-count initial+final evaluation.

conclusions.legacy_equivalence: All 60 declared fixed-depth pairs match the recorded exact graph fields with pawn structure disabled; this is sampled equivalence, not proof for every legal position.
conclusions.evaluation_cost: With pawn shield enabled, structure adds about 23.7 percent evaluator-only median paired cost in this corpus.
conclusions.search_cost: At depth 3, structure ON/OFF median paired wall ratio is approximately 1.00366 baseline-over-candidate (near parity), while nodes/PV/scores intentionally differ. Per-position and per-pair times vary. This is a short fixed-depth cost sample, not an equal-time strength test.
conclusions.playing_strength: No new self-play, Elo, win-rate, or strength improvement has been measured. Added correct heuristic behavior and passing rules do not establish stronger play.
conclusions.external_load: Observed non-target and browser load was nonzero. Do not claim idle host or CPU isolation. The aggregate is incomplete and cannot precisely attribute interference to each search sample.

detail.method: Linux sha256sum captured raw CRLF files in the Windows-mounted checkout. Compare manifest to current raw bytes, then normalize CRLF to LF and compare byte-for-byte with frozen Git blobs.

auditor_notes: An initial audit comparison mistakenly compared raw-CRLF Linux manifest hashes directly with LF Git blob hashes. The corrected method verifies raw manifest bytes first and then normalized frozen-source equality; all 21 manifest files match. This correction changed only this audit JSON.
